adjudication_records.issue_text: packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts:255-257 — updateEvent's no-externalCalendarId fallback is dead code: the find predicate compares cal.externalId === null/undefined and never matches, so updateEvent is called with calendarId undefined, causing a Google 404 and the calendar event never being updated while reschedule appears successful

adjudication.rationale:
In `GoogleCalendarService.updateEvent`, the fallback when `externalCalendarId` is falsy is:


adjudication_records.issue_text: packages/core/EventManager.ts:570-585 — per-reference sequential prisma.credential.findUnique calls inside the loop serialize N DB round-trips that could be one findMany({ id: { in: [...] } }), adding latency to the reschedule/confirm path for collective bookings

adjudication.rationale: In packages/core/EventManager.ts, the updated logic now processes multiple calendar references by looping `for (const reference of calendarReference)` and, when a referenced credential isn’t found in `this.calendarCredentials`, it does an `await prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: reference.credentialId } ... })` inside that loop (see the new block around the per-reference fallback fetch).
